name: Portal
description: A 1x4x5 portal built on the game's window brick: through it you see out of its partner, and you walk in one and out of the other. Two portals of one owner with the same brick Name (wrench) are a pair; two placed in a row are named to match. More of one name form a ring, like Teledoors. Unpaired, it is shut glass. Options > Graphics > Mirrors sets how many show their view live.
